The station Svartberget, with ICOS code SE-Svb, is located about 70 km west of the Gulf of Bothnia, NW of the city Umea. The site in a northern Sweden boreal forest in a landscape characterized by the ridges, valleys and lakes stretching from northwest to southeast, and the station is located within the Svartberget Experimental forest, about 1520 hectare forest land with forest research activities since 1909.
